task: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First, it would be fantastic if you could make an attempt to venture south. And then, attempt to head east. And then, make an attempt to go to the north. Then, head east. Once you succeed at that, lift the keycard from the floor of the shower. And if you do that, you're the winner!
description:
This might come as a shock to you, but you've just fallen into a bedchamber.

You make out a bed stand. But the thing hasn't got anything on it. Hopefully, this discovery doesn't ruin your TextWorld experience!

There is a closed formless hatch leading east. There is an open door leading north. There is an unguarded exit to the south.

thought: I should first go south as instructed.
